class_meanings.none: Very little modelled water erosion; not zero or a safe-loss guarantee
class_meanings.high: Published high or higher erosion bands combined

rules.rationale: Pete approved these four class definitions on 2026-11-25: Very little 0-1; Low >1-3; Medium >3-5; High >5 tonnes/ha/year. Retain published very-low, low and moderate bands; merge published high and higher bands. RuralScan uses upper-inclusive endpoints. The article applies European Soil Bureau bands globally; 5 starts its high class while 10 is its separate generic tolerable-erosion benchmark, neither a soil-specific safe-loss guarantee. Approval covers the class interpretation; the documentation-only binding and runtime release remain unapproved. See priority/research/2026-11-25-soil-erosion-global-classes.md for the approval quote and rationale.
